name: Lack Of Knowledge
overview: Scripture reveals that a lack of knowledge is deeply connected to rejecting the fear of the LORD and despising wisdom and instruction, which leads to folly and sinfulness. Proverbs emphasizes that true knowledge begins with reverence for God, and without it, the soul suffers and hastens into sin. Wisdom and understanding are foundational for building and establishing a life that honors God, while the absence of knowledge results in spiritual and practical ruin.
